trace.cypher: MATCH (t:Team)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document), (p:Player)-[:PlaysFor]->(t), (p)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) WHERE t.team_name IS NOT NULL AND (t.team_name = 'Boston Celtics' OR CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) <= 0 OR CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS INT64) < 0) WITH DISTINCT t, p RETURN t.team_name AS col1, AVG(CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS DOUBLE)) AS col2
